choose.when:
SELECT
parent_name AS itemName, SUM(qty) AS qty, SUM(qtyFree) AS qtyFree, SUM(total_price) AS totalPrice
parent_name AS parentName, product_name AS itemName, product_code AS code, qty AS qty, qtyFree AS qtyFree, qty_uom_name AS uomName, unit_price AS unitPrice, total_price AS totalPrice
trans_type AS type, order_date AS date, product_code AS code, code AS invoiceCode, product_name AS itemName, qty AS qty, qtyFree AS qtyFree, customer_name AS organizationName, location_name AS warehouseName, qty_uom_name AS uomName, unit_price AS unitPrice, total_price AS totalPrice
FROM ( SELECT IF(is_pos=1,'POS','Invoice') AS trans_type, (SELECT parent_id FROM products WHERE id = product_id) AS parent_id, IFNULL((SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ',code,'-',name) FROM products WHERE id = (SELECT parent_id FROM products WHERE id = sales_order_details.product_id)), 'No Parent') AS parent_name, product_id, (SELECT code FROM products WHERE id = product_id) AS product_code, (SELECT name FROM products WHERE id = product_id) AS product_name, order_date, so_code AS code, (SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ',customer_code,name) FROM customers WHERE id = customer_id) AS customer_name, (SELECT name FROM locations WHERE id = location_id) AS location_name, qty AS qty, qty_free AS qtyFree, conversion, (SELECT price_uom_id FROM products WHERE id = sales_order_details.product_id) AS qty_uom_id, (SELECT name FROM uoms WHERE id = qty_uom_id) AS qty_uom_name, unit_price, total_price FROM sales_orders INNER JOIN sales_order_details ON sales_orders.id = sales_order_details.sales_order_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Credit Memo' AS trans_type, (SELECT parent_id FROM products WHERE id = product_id) AS parent_id, IFNULL((SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ',code,'-',name) FROM products WHERE id = (SELECT parent_id FROM products WHERE id = credit_memo_details.product_id)), 'No Parent') AS parent_name, product_id, (SELECT code FROM products WHERE id = product_id) AS product_code, (SELECT name FROM products WHERE id = product_id) AS product_name, order_date, cm_code AS code, (SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ',customer_code,name) FROM customers WHERE id = customer_id) AS customer_name, (SELECT name FROM locations WHERE id = location_id) AS location_name, (qty * -1) AS qty, (qty_free * -1) AS qtyFree, conversion, (SELECT price_uom_id FROM products WHERE id = credit_memo_details.product_id) AS qty_uom_id, (SELECT name FROM uoms WHERE id = qty_uom_id) AS qty_uom_name, unit_price, total_price * -1 FROM credit_memos INNER JOIN credit_memo_details ON credit_memos.id = credit_memo_details.credit_memo_id
) AS result
GROUP BY parent_name
ORDER BY itemName
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT
service_name AS itemName, SUM(qty) AS qty, SUM(qtyFree) AS qtyFree, SUM(total_price) AS totalPrice
service_name AS itemName, qty AS qty, qtyFree AS qtyFree, total_price AS totalPrice
trans_type AS type, service_name AS itemName, order_date AS date, code AS invoiceCode, customer_name AS organizationName, location_name AS warehouseName, qty AS qty, qtyFree AS qtyFree, unit_price AS unitPrice, total_price AS totalPrice
FROM ( SELECT IF(is_pos=1,'POS','Invoice') AS trans_type, service_id, (SELECT name FROM services WHERE id=service_id) AS service_name, order_date, so_code AS code, (SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ',customer_code,name) FROM customers WHERE id=customer_id) AS customer_name, (SELECT name FROM locations WHERE id=location_id) AS location_name, qty AS qty, qty_free AS qtyFree, NULL AS qty_uom_name, unit_price, total_price FROM sales_orders INNER JOIN sales_order_services ON sales_orders.id=sales_order_services.sales_order_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Credit Memo' AS trans_type, service_id, (SELECT name FROM services WHERE id=service_id) AS service_name, order_date, cm_code AS code, (SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ',customer_code,name) FROM customers WHERE id=customer_id) AS customer_name, (SELECT name FROM locations WHERE id=location_id) AS location_name, (qty * -1) AS qty, (qty_free * -1) AS qtyFree, NULL AS qty_uom_name, unit_price, total_price FROM credit_memos INNER JOIN credit_memo_services ON credit_memos.id=credit_memo_services.credit_memo_id
) AS result
GROUP BY service_name
ORDER BY itemName
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT

description AS itemName, qty AS qty, qtyFree AS qtyFree, total_price AS totalPrice
trans_type AS type, description AS itemName, order_date AS date, code AS invoiceCode, customer_name AS organizationName, location_name AS locationName, qty AS qty, qtyFree AS qtyFree, qty_uom_name AS uomName, unit_price AS unitPrice, total_price AS totalPrice
FROM ( SELECT IF(is_pos=1,'POS','Invoice') AS trans_type, description, order_date, so_code AS code, (SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ',customer_code,name) FROM customers WHERE id=customer_id) AS customer_name, (SELECT name FROM locations WHERE id=location_id) AS location_name, qty AS qty, qty_free AS qtyFree, (SELECT abbr FROM uoms WHERE id=qty_uom_id) AS qty_uom_name, unit_price, total_price FROM sales_orders INNER JOIN sales_order_miscs ON sales_orders.id = sales_order_miscs.sales_order_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Credit Memo' AS trans_type, description, order_date, cm_code AS code, (SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ',customer_code,name) FROM customers WHERE id=customer_id) AS customer_name, (SELECT name FROM locations WHERE id=location_id) AS location_name, (qty * -1) AS qty, (qty_free * -1) AS qtyFree, (SELECT name FROM uoms WHERE id=qty_uom_id) AS qty_uom_name, unit_price, total_price FROM credit_memos INNER JOIN credit_memo_miscs ON credit_memos.id = credit_memo_miscs.credit_memo_id
) AS result
GROUP BY description
ORDER BY itemName
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
SELECT sales_orders.id FROM sales_orders INNER JOIN sales_order_details ON sales_orders.id = sales_order_details.sales_order_id INNER JOIN products ON sales_order_details.product_id = products.id LEFT JOIN product_pgroups ON sales_order_details.product_id = product_pgroups.product_id LEFT JOIN pgroups ON product_pgroups.pgroup_id = pgroups.id AND pgroups.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN customers ON sales_orders.customer_id = customers.id LEFT JOIN location_groups ON sales_orders.location_group_id = location_groups.id LEFT JOIN uoms ON sales_order_details.qty_uom_id = uoms.id
UNION ALL
SELECT credit_memos.id FROM credit_memos INNER JOIN credit_memo_details ON credit_memos.id = credit_memo_details.credit_memo_id INNER JOIN products ON credit_memo_details.product_id = products.id LEFT JOIN product_pgroups ON credit_memo_details.product_id = product_pgroups.product_id LEFT JOIN pgroups ON product_pgroups.pgroup_id = pgroups.id AND pgroups.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN customers ON credit_memos.customer_id = customers.id LEFT JOIN location_groups ON credit_memos.location_group_id = location_groups.id LEFT JOIN uoms ON credit_memo_details.qty_uom_id = uoms.id

SELECT sales_orders.id FROM sales_orders INNER JOIN sales_order_miscs ON sales_orders.id = sales_order_miscs.sales_order_id LEFT JOIN customers ON sales_orders.customer_id = customers.id LEFT JOIN location_groups ON sales_orders.location_group_id = location_groups.id LEFT JOIN uoms ON sales_order_miscs.qty_uom_id = uoms.id
